series_policy: 12 archived series modeled separately with their original units and per-series chronological splits
test_policy: One predeclared comparison of the three fixed methods; report the validation-selected method. No test-driven tuning, thresholding, filtering or refit.
fixed_origin: End of training segment; all validation and test months predicted without observing subsequent actual values
quality_policy: Preserve flags and all original measurements; unresolved source-review flags mean results are exploratory. Report flag-free evaluation sensitivity, not silently cleaned data.
forecast_constraints: Month-start dates only. No daily forecasts, clipping, invented regressors, event-cost conversion or LKR/index pooling. Flag nonpositive predictions rather than silently repair them.
metrics: MAE and RMSE in each series unit; MASE uses training-only seasonal lag-12 absolute differences; sMAPE explicitly 0..200 percent. Never average raw MAE/RMSE across different units.
future_deployment: Not part of this evaluation; no refit to full data or future-date forecasts yet
